name: Red Wings Widget
description: Detroit Red Wings NHL schedule widget + companion app: next-game countdown, last result, and division standings.
changelog: Added 5 Official Red Wings Jersey Themes: Heritage 1926 (Cougars/Winter Classic), Home Red (LCA Sweater), Away White (Road Sweater), Reverse Retro 2.0 (2022 Black Sweater), and Stadium Series (2016 Special Alternate).
Permanently resolved dark theme text legibility issues by standardizing on pure white typography (#FFFFFF) meeting WCAG AAA contrast standards (up to 19.8:1).
Enabled bidirectional theme synchronization between the home screen widget and companion app via shared preferences.
Enhanced widget theme toggle with dedicated jersey badge chips and authentic jersey border styling.
